c.title: $5,795 / 3br - 2800ft2 - West Point Grey 3 Bed + Den Family Home Near Beaches & Schools (West Point Grey)
c.description:
3878 West 8th Avenue, Vancouver BC

Well-maintained 3-bedroom + den, 2.5-bath character home in sought-after West Point Grey. Approx. 2,800 sq. ft. over two levels with hardwood floors, bright living spaces, and a flexible layout ideal for families or professionals.

Private front and back yards, plus parking pad with EV charging. Plenty of free street parking available.

Prime location near Jericho, Locarno, and Spanish Banks beaches, Royal Vancouver Yacht Club, and Jericho Tennis & Sailing Centres. Close to UBC, West Point Grey Academy, shops, cafés, and amenities along West 4th, West Broadway, and West 10th. Easy commute downtown.

📅 1-year lease
🚭 No smoking
🐾 Small pet considered
